## 主张 Claim

有限列表覆盖全部根基指标时，完整闭包逐命题存在可接纳解释，等价于一个可接纳解释满足整个闭包。 / When a finite list covers all basis indices, pointwise admissible interpretation of the full derived closure is equivalent to one admissible interpretation satisfying the entire closure.

Canonical source: [JointInterpretation.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/inquiry-root/JointInterpretation.lean)

- 既有 Derives、有限覆盖列表与显式 admissible；逐命题覆盖包括全部可导公式。 / Existing Derives, a finite covering list and explicit admissible; pointwise coverage includes every derivable formula.
